The connection point where the white cable meets the black dock connector at the bottom left is messy. The geometry of the plug and the port seems fused or ill-defined, lacking the precise mechanical tolerance of a real Apple accessory.

The text labels on the click wheel (Menu, Next, etc.) are faint and slightly distorted, not perfectly aligned with the curvature of the wheel. The surface texture also lacks the subtle matte finish usually seen on these wheels, appearing slightly too glossy/smooth.
